g.text: Detection engine - the passes and what they borrow
, not per run: a folder's own
may hand this file a different
phrase, language or mark placement than the last one.
That is what makes "no per-file state survives" a
structural property rather than a matter of remembering
"every piece of per-region probe state starts
fresh" structural, not a reset somebody has to
passes do to a mark once its
default-mode position is known. One implementation,
so Probe and Scan cannot place marks differently.
Pure Analyze geometry over VAD speech
the same members. Merging them would give each pass
fields the other ignores - which is how a pass ends up
reading with the wrong model. Do not "tidy" into a base.
